title: Art and Illustration
description:
I've always had a great passion for drawing and for capturing ideas in a visual way. I've done illustrations and digital art for a wide variety of projects related to video games, board games, cartoons and world design. I work with Photoshop and Illustrator, tools with which I am very experienced and fluent.

I like to bring my characters to life with vibrant colors, clear expressions and a well-defined personality. I especially enjoy cartoon styles with exaggerated expressions, although I have also created semi-realistic illustrations, concept art, scenarios, characters, blueprints, interfaces (UI), photomontages and digital edition pieces.
